mapper.sql: select column_id, table_id, column_name, column_comment, column_type, java_type, java_field, is_pk, is_increment, is_required, is_insert, is_edit, is_list, is_query, query_type, html_type, dict_type, sort, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from gen_table_column
mapper.select: select c.column_name, (case when upper(c.nullable) = 'N' and pk.column_name is null then '1' else null end) as is_required, (case when pk.column_name is not null then '1' else '0' end) as is_pk, c.column_id as sort, coalesce(cc.comments, '') as column_comment, (case when ai.column_name is not null then '1' else '0' end) as is_increment, (case when upper(c.data_type) in ('VARCHAR', 'VARCHAR2', 'NVARCHAR', 'NVARCHAR2') then lower(c.data_type) || '(' || c.data_length || ')' when upper(c.data_type) in ('CHAR', 'NCHAR') then lower(c.data_type) || '(' || c.data_length || ')' when upper(c.data_type) in ('TEXT', 'CLOB') then 'text' when upper(c.data_type) = 'BLOB' then 'blob' when upper(c.data_type) = 'SMALLINT' then 'smallint' when upper(c.data_type) in ('INTEGER', 'INT') then 'int' when upper(c.data_type) = 'BIGINT' then 'bigint' when upper(c.data_type) = 'BIT' then 'bit' when upper(c.data_type) = 'NUMBER' and c.data_precision is not null and nvl(c.data_scale, 0) > 0 then 'decimal(' || c.data_precision || ',' || c.data_scale || ')' when upper(c.data_type) = 'NUMBER' and c.data_precision is not null then 'number(' || c.data_precision || ')' when upper(c.data_type) = 'DATE' then 'date' when upper(c.data_type) like 'TIME%' then 'time' when upper(c.data_type) like 'TIMESTAMP%' then 'timestamp' else lower(c.data_type) end) as column_type from all_tab_columns c left join all_col_comments cc on cc.owner = c.owner and cc.table_name = c.table_name and cc.column_name = c.column_name left join ( select acc.owner, acc.table_name, acc.column_name from all_constraints ac join all_cons_columns acc on ac.owner = acc.owner and ac.constraint_name = acc.constraint_name and ac.table_name = acc.table_name where ac.constraint_type = 'P' ) pk on pk.owner = c.owner and pk.table_name = c.table_name and pk.column_name = c.column_name left join ( select SF_GET_SCHEMA_NAME_BY_ID(obj.schid) as owner, obj.name as table_name, col.name as column_name from sys.syscolumns col join sys.sysobjects obj on obj.id = col.id where col.info2 & 0x01 = 0x01 and obj.type$ = 'SCHOBJ' and obj.subtype$ = 'UTAB' ) ai on ai.owner = c.owner and ai.table_name = c.table_name and ai.column_name = c.column_name where c.owner = SF_GET_SCHEMA_NAME_BY_ID(CURRENT_SCHID()) and c.table_name = upper(#{tableName}) order by c.column_id
mapper.insert: insert into gen_table_column ( table_id, column_name, column_comment, column_type, java_type, java_field, is_pk, is_increment, is_required, is_insert, is_edit, is_list, is_query, query_type, html_type, dict_type, sort, create_by, create_time )values( #{tableId}, #{columnName}, #{columnComment}, #{columnType}, #{javaType}, #{javaField}, #{isPk}, #{isIncrement}, #{isRequired}, #{isInsert}, #{isEdit}, #{isList}, #{isQuery}, #{queryType}, #{htmlType}, #{dictType}, #{sort}, #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.delete:
delete from gen_table_column where table_id in
#{tableId}

#{item.columnId}
